purpose: Prospective actual delivered fetch-body observation on every selected engine, without Inspector/Juggler body storage or an HTTP replay
installBefore: context.addInitScript before creating/navigating the first page and in every fresh document

fetch.call: Reflect.apply the captured native fetch with the original receiver and original arguments; return that exact original Promise and its original Response without substitution
fetch.observe: Clone each actual fulfilled native Response once; read the complete clone stream within the literal byte budgets and SHA256 its exact decoded bytes with crypto.subtle
fetch.methodProvenance: Do not reread Request/init properties or getters. The actual method, phase and documentEpoch are joined from the unique browser request-ledger row; raw browser records identify this provenance explicitly
fetch.ownership: Retain only bounded metadata after digest; release clone reader/chunks. Cancel only the observation clone on budget/error, never the original Response
fetch.failures: Rejected native fetch, clone/read/digest error, incomplete body, overflow, unmatched/ambiguous/duplicate record or request, document/timeOrigin mismatch all FAIL
fetch.rejectionQualification: Attaching the observation rejection handler can mark a native fetch Promise handled. Every such rejection independently records an observer error and fails the row; no successful result relies on the host unhandled-rejection event for that fetch.

join.scope: Every network fetch in the fixed DOM and four-document runtime graphs on every selected engine; never only the two large responses
join.identity: Within one recorded documentEpoch/timeOrigin, a completed browser record must match exactly one allowed GET fetch request by actual response/request URL and status. Frozen graphs issue each fetch URL once per document; ambiguity fails rather than selecting by timing
join.phase: Keep the request ledger phase measured before routing; include that phase and documentEpoch in the joined body observation
join.beforeDeparture: Each runtime epoch must have a completed operation-phase settle/checkpoint before bootstrap advances to the next document; retain that epoch's full body join before navigation
join.settle: Await active clone reads/digests after actual ready and each existing completion window; require zero pending observations and complete two-way joins, including the final cleanup window
join.oracles: Actual status/MIME/response headers, full byte length and SHA256 equal the existing reviewed asset binding; original request allowlist/counts, failed-request, CSP/error/sentinel checks remain strict

otherResponses: Document/script/stylesheet and other non-fetch responses retain actual Playwright response.body() observation
qualification: The byte budgets bound bytes read/retained by this observer per body and cumulatively per document, not native fetch tee buffering, all transient digest allocations, allocator peak, RSS or production memory
